title: Save an engineering definition for later sessions
actor: An engineer or engineering agent authoring an engineering definition
goal: Explicitly save an identifiable engineering definition so its recorded content can be retrieved after the authoring session ends.
context: The author has developed a definition within one governed project model and needs the work to remain available to later participants.
trigger: The author decides to retain the definition beyond the current session.
preconditions: The author has the entity identity, type, and authored content to save.
The selected governed model and the intended scope of the save are identifiable.

interaction.action: Identifies the governed model and supplies the entity identity, type, and authored definition with an explicit request to save it.
Reports whether the requested definition was retained, identifying the saved entity and resulting model state or the known failure or incomplete scope.
Uses the reported outcome to distinguish content confirmed as saved from work whose retention is unconfirmed before ending the session.

expected_outcome: The author receives confirmation identifying the retained entity, type, content, and model state, so later participants can retrieve that saved definition without the originating conversation or private session state.

alternatives.condition: Another entity has the same display name but a different identity.
alternatives.outcome: The system distinguishes the entities by identity; the matching name alone does not prevent saving the intended definition.

failures.condition: The submitted identity is missing or conflicts with a distinct entity in the selected model.
failures.outcome: The system reports the missing identity or conflict and does not present the proposed state as valid or unambiguous.

failures.condition: The entity type or representation is outside the declared supported authoring profile.
failures.outcome: The system reports the unsupported content and does not claim that it was accepted as a supported saved definition.

failures.condition: Saving fails or retention of the complete requested definition cannot be confirmed.
failures.outcome: The system reports the known outcome and affected scope without claiming complete retention.

sources.basis: Extracts the independently valuable author-saving goal previously embedded in SCN-001. IR-001 and SR-001 already require explicit retention for later sessions, and SR-002 already requires unambiguous entity identity; no new capability or obligation is introduced.

Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage. This confirms analysis only, not requirement approval, implementation, or satisfaction.
